headline: Top-Ranked USC Hosts Struggling Spartans in Week 2
subhead: The number one Trojans look to stay perfect against a Michigan State offense searching for rhythm.

xFactor.why: Miller Moss ranks sixth in the PCFL with 276 yards and three touchdowns through the air.

keyMatchup: USC's seventh-ranked defense allowing 358 yards per game against a Michigan State offense ranked seventeenth at 215 yards per game.
body: USC enters as the PCFL's top-ranked team at 1-0, averaging 27 points and 424 total yards behind quarterback Miller Moss, who threw for 276 yards and three scores in the opener, while rusher Carter Myers added 86 yards on the ground. The Trojans defense sits seventh in the league at 358 yards allowed per game and features pass rusher Anthony Lucas with a sack and ballhawk Ricky Scott with an interception.

Michigan State dropped its opener 25-18 at Washington and now travels 0-1 with the league's seventeenth-ranked offense at 215 yards per game, split between 118 passing and 97 rushing. Quarterback Arnold Glass ranks twelfth in the PCFL with 144 yards and two touchdowns, but the Spartans defense, ninth at 367 yards allowed, must contain a balanced USC attack averaging 263 yards through the air and 161 on the ground.
